gen-dafont-capture-smallz-gf-abeezee: Big-bodied lowercase gives Capture Smallz a raw, tactical bluntness that grabs attention at once. And ABeeZee, a sans-serif with glassy neon-tube strokes and round letters, keeps its approachable manner.
gen-dafont-capture-smallz-gf-aldrich: Blunt meets tubular: Capture Smallz hits with big-bodied lowercase, while Aldrich draws its lines like a single thick thread. Raw on top, modern underneath, they hold a page together.
gen-dafont-capture-smallz-gf-alexandria: Alexandria reads clean and tall, its c terminals flung open and its stems short above and below. But Capture Smallz adds raw, tactical weight with its big-bodied lowercase, so the two never blur.
gen-dafont-capture-smallz-gf-amiko: Raw describes Capture Smallz well, with its big-bodied lowercase and tactical bluntness up front. And Amiko follows with lowercase strokes tall as crayon marks and terminals that point outward like tongs.
gen-dafont-capture-smallz-gf-anek-bangla: Capture Smallz is all raw, tactical swagger, built on big-bodied lowercase that fills the line. Anek Bangla does a gentler job, with wide s curves barely curled in and a short climb from midline to ascender.
gen-dafont-capture-smallz-gf-anek-devana: Big-bodied lowercase makes Capture Smallz feel raw and tactical before a single word is read. Anek Devanagari feels modern and measured next to it, its letter mouths open and its middle zone tall.
gen-dafont-capture-smallz-gf-anek-gujara: Clean and approachable, this body face has lowercase that rivals the capitals, while Capture Smallz brings raw, tactical bulk. Anek Gujarati keeps paragraphs open and friendly, its wide c mouth never tiring the eye over pages.
gen-dafont-capture-smallz-gf-anek-gurmuk: Clean is the first word for Anek Gurmukhi, a sans-serif with big open counters in every small letter. Yet Capture Smallz stays raw and tactical with big-bodied lowercase, giving those open curves something blunt to play against.
gen-dafont-capture-smallz-gf-anek-kannad: Contemporary in feel, Anek Kannada lifts its x-height like a squared-off woodblock letter and stops terminals far from the stem. Capture Smallz adds the raw, tactical muscle on top.
gen-dafont-capture-smallz-gf-anek-latin: Letters held open rather than curled shut, climbing nearly to cap height, make this sans read clear and level. Anek Latin takes the quiet work while Capture Smallz supplies the raw, tactical punch.
